$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the captured pipeline with one deviation, the evidence upload conditioned on failure() instead of always(). A passing run then leaves no evidence bundle, which is the case AD-12 says the upload exists to prevent.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean. The upload of evals/grader/runs/ names runs/ and its if is failure(), which is not always(), so the artifact element misses. The other seven elements are present and nothing unrequested was added.

elementMisses: artifact-evaluation-runs: the upload of runs/ does not run under always()
